correctness.rationale: For positive spike a and S_a e0=a e1 with later weights 1, RESULT.md decomposes (S⊗S*+S*⊗S)/2 into homogeneous real Jacobi blocks, then parity-reflected ± blocks. Uniform exterior Chebyshev Schur complements converge to f(lambda)=lambda-(a²/2)rho(lambda), and f=0 permits |rho|<1 precisely when a>sqrt(2), giving ±E=a²/(2sqrt(a²-1)). Separate parity-adapted Weyl sequences prove [-1,1] essential and boundary-localized ±E essential; no other exterior accumulation. Thus Fredholm essential spectra both equal band alone at/below threshold, plus detached ±E above; essential norm follows, not full norm. Independent numerical Jacobi and parity-folded block eigenvalues at n=120 for a=1,1.4,sqrt2,1.8,2.4 corroborated threshold and E to numerical precision. Unrestricted proof is resolvent convergence plus Weyl criterion, not numerics; low n blocks do not change essential spectrum.
